description: Provenance of every dataset file used by the project. Raw files live in data/raw/ (git-ignored, fetched by scripts/fetch_datasets.py); processed tables in data/processed/ (scripts/preprocess_datasets.py).

provenance_classes.public_real: real-world observations from a published dataset
provenance_classes.room101_measured: measurements from the project's real room (Office A, ESP32-S3 board)
provenance_classes.synthetic: generated by the project's simulator (twin/), never real measurements
provenance_classes.derived: computed from other values (e.g. humidity ratio from temperature and RH)

uci_occupancy.name: Occupancy Detection
uci_occupancy.publisher: UCI Machine Learning Repository; data by Luis M. Candanedo (University of Mons)
uci_occupancy.citation: Candanedo, L.M., Feldheim, V. (2016). Accurate occupancy detection of an office room from light, temperature, humidity and CO2 measurements using statistical learning models. Energy and Buildings 112, 28-39.
uci_occupancy.download_source: https://github.com/LuisM78/Occupancy-detection-data (the dataset author's repository; the UCI archive host was refused by this environment's network proxy)
uci_occupancy.licence: CC BY 4.0 (as stated on the UCI landing page, read 2026-10-23)

bdg2.name: The Building Data Genome Project 2 (BDG2)
bdg2.publisher: BUDS Lab, National University of Singapore (Miller et al.)
bdg2.citation: Miller, C., Kathirgamanathan, A., Picchetti, B. et al. (2020). The Building Data Genome Project 2, energy meter data from the ASHRAE Great Energy Predictor III competition. Scientific Data 7, 368. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-020-00712-x
bdg2.download_source: media.githubusercontent.com (Git LFS objects of the repository, master branch)
bdg2.licence: Repository LICENSE file: 'Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0' (Creative Commons BY-SA 4.0); read 2026-10-23
bdg2.units: meter files: kWh per hour for electricity (paper: 'units kWhsum for the energy-related meters'); weather: NOAA ISD-Lite (degC, m/s, oktas, mm, hPa); timestamps local time (checked: Panther air temperature peaks at 14:00)

existing_copies.Dataset/UCI/occupancy+detection/*: byte-identical to the uci_occupancy raw files (same SHA-256)
existing_copies.Dataset/Kaggle_Room_Occupancy/datatraini: byte-identical to the uci_occupancy raw files: the 'Kaggle' dataset is a re-upload of UCI, not an independent dataset
the three UCI files concatenated (20,560 rows = 8,143 + 2,665 + 9,752)
existing_copies.Dataset/Kaggle_Room_Occupancy/file.csv: datatest.txt without the date column (2,665 rows)
existing_copies.data/raw/simulated_occupancy_data*.csv: synthetic, produced by the earlier simulator (archived code); not used by the current models
